I heard the buzz about this game a few months ago, decided to fly on over to the steam wishlist to see what would be good value. This game is absolute honey. None of that souls like vinegar acetic nonsense where its difficult for difficulties sake. The only thing that bugged me was the animation interpolation but there were sliders to fix my problems.

Its cheaper than an overpriced sandwich and far more fulfilling.
Game holds your hand the entire time. Possibly a 2/10 puzzle type game for me. Something I'd recommend to early teenagers.

Loved it. Played as a team of two. Not used to playing "Top Down" camera games but this was fun. Not to difficult yet difficult enough to keep you on your toes. Graphics are decent, I like the cartoon style. Interesting story. Great little game at a decent price. Thanks!

I played this because I loved his later games, and while it isn't as long or in depth, this one still scratches that itch. If you played Islets, Crypt Custodian, or Well Dweller, and want more of that, this is a nice buy.

These three guys are the epidemy of Icarus. They thought if they took a small hiatus to make some improvements for stability and other backend stuff that this game was gonna soar higher than it already was...that was TWO YEARS AGO. They were literally at the top of the squad based large scale combat and just packed up and left. Super disappointing because this game really was gas so much it was diesel. It had the old battlefield feel with triple the player count. They keep trying to post updates, about THE update, but haven't released anything...

Don't buy this game, it is essentially dead and abandoned by the developers AND the players.
Another great installment from this studio, gorgeous design and just enough challenge of a platformer to keep you engaged. Highly recommend.
all action side scroller shooter.   Wish this game was out in the 90's in the hype of T2!

Besides the fact this game has no one playing it. My friend and I bought the game. We had a ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ blast. The bots do try to murder you if they are the killer. They do collect resources and hoard them sometimes. This game is fun to play with friends. A dead game is only dead until people revive it. Does it need some optimization? Yeah, a bit, there is a delay in when the game announces someone dies. A mic bug that's solved by leaving the lobby and coming back. Those are my biggest issues. However, I love the look of it cause it's like those old PS2 games honestly. I've seen worse graphics. This game is fun and we bought it on a sale. Major props to the Dev who kept putting out content and bug fixes when the game slowed down. Even put out a Halloween event. I hope it comes out this year too, cause I would like to play it with my friends.

Yes, only if you buy it with the dlc on sale. Do not buy it at full price. it isn't worth it if you just want to go through the story for both - the base game and the dlc. However, it's the second best modern doom game in my opinion. i finished what I wanted to see and hear. i almost got 13 hours. if they had something like the multiplayer from doom 2016, i would play more.

In the native Linux version the laser eyes sometimes disappears, making those levels very easy to complete.

When I run the game through proton I get an extremely annoying audio bug. It is just some very loud and annoying sounds that plays at random intervals making the game unplayable with sound.

I played the game a long time ago on Xbox and had fun with it back then. Not sure why games tend to degrade over time?!?!?!?!?
Amazing game, so high energy and so much fun.
Very interesting. Perfect for four players who hate each other.

7/10. A short game with great atmosphere at the start and doesn't overstay its welcome. Combat is fun with some variety and different ways to approach. However Invisible enemies aren't fun to fight against, even though they are only equipped with box cutters. I feel like they ruined the vibe near the end.. Also it would be better if the game has a bit more gore when you kill enemies in creative ways. Overall I had a fun time.

Yet another great little indie platformer,.

The monochrome world really pops with the fantastic art style and atmosphere, the puzzles are fun but not difficult which is fine, not all of these types of games need to be difficult.

Where the game really stands out is the dystopian story an influences from Animal Farm, the story is brutal and very good.

All in all another indie banger and well worth playing.
very very fun and satifieing. this game is VERY difficult but i love it and love the difficulty

The last good game of a now dead studio killed by bethesda (microslop). Last good Void Engine game.
Dishonored DotH or Dishonored 2.5 is a standalone expansion in Dishonored universe. You have the same lore, familiar characters, mechanics and a few new fun "toys". It's worth the price of now (2026) of 30€? hell nah! but for 5€ it's worth it. The story is composed of 5 missions that you can do in about 30 minutes each if you rush to the main objective or 2-3 hours if you collect everything. Achievements are easy to get.
My second Kyle Thompson game after Well Dweller. I'm definitely going to buy and play the rest of his games, because this guy really knows how to make fun metroidvanias.

This game was funny af while also having voice acting which made the game even BETTER!!

Ya'll, $2.99 for this game is an extremely fair price and personally, I'd say do it.

This game is worthwhile 🤗

PEAK. This game is glorious in story and visuals, and even as someone who primarily plays "cozy games" this has checked all my boxes. However, if you plan to play it on a laptop I would be very, very cautious, I got through around 20 hours of the game before it began to slow down even further than it already had and became pretty much unplayable, we're talking lowest possible graphics and a solid 5fps. I'm lucky enough to now play on a decent PC but I would make sure your device can handle the bulk of this game before getting too invested.

I couldn't review this previously because it just wouldn't run correctly on either of my PCs. I had hoped it'd be a good travel game on my laptop, but didn't work. However, it works great on the Steam Frame, and I've really been enjoying it. Sort of gives me Dave the Diver timed vibes, but with some pretty plot specific cop stuff.

If you enjoy the Metroidvania genre, if you want to play a game that makes you smile because of its character development (Egbert, for example), or if you simply want to play something that warms your soul with good vibes, this game is for you.
Don't hesitate to buy it. Kyle Thompson absolutely deserves our support.

The one game that gave me the same itch and sense of accomplishment that Sekiro gave me. 100% was supposed to be the Game of the Year when it released. Definitely looking forward to future games that Game Science releases and this gave me a great introduction to the Journey to the West which I intend to read soon.
Great game!  Amazing art style and ambiance, unique mechanics, and overall a fun MV.

Definitely my personal favorite game of 2026. I already finished it completely on console and it runs even better on my laptop. The story is fantastic, the graphics are amazing and the new absolute difficulty really adds a challenge to the game.

*Excellent Action-Adventure Game - Highly Recommended!

Rise of the Tomb Raider is a fantastic game with beautiful environments, impressive graphics, and engaging gameplay. The exploration, combat, puzzles, and tombs offer a great balance of action and adventure.

Even years after its release, the game still looks amazing on PC. The atmosphere, story, and attention to detail make the experience genuinely enjoyable.

If you enjoy cinematic action-adventure games with rewarding exploration, this is definitely worth playing!

Highly recommended!
SO much fun. Me and my buddy played this with my gf once and even though it wasnt her favorite he and i still run duos on it and its still just as fun if a little more challenging
A beautiful puzzle plataformer with very satisfying movement

I thought this was gonna suck ass but playing in a group of 3-4 it was more fun/interesting than expected. kind of an RTS-like challenge where you're trying to optimize your time spent as much as possible to not get outpaced by the rapidly scaling enemy difficulty

Duck Game is exactly what you think it'd be: chaos, fun, and varied in content.

This game has a lot to it despite its rather small file size. In this game, you can create your own levels, play various arcade missions, and of course play the multiplayer mode. I do think that the online feature is probably the most enjoyable portion of this game, but the arcade challenges were definitely rewarding to play as well.

Once I got a hang of the controls (I try not to alter controls unless they're absolutely unbearable at default), this game was easy to pick up on. I've not played a game in a while that didn't use my mouse to shoot so I fumbled around the keys to try and figure it out, gave up, then went to the main menu to check the key bindings.

Great fun arcade game.
İf you just want to get a feeling of satisfaction, go and crush some heads. It's totally worth it.

Definitely a departure from the typical Hitman gameplay. It's a lot of fun, but it does reduce or eliminate a lot of what makes the series so memorable. Overall a good time, but I would not take it over Contracts or Blood Money.
Absolutely gorgeous game. The mechanics are so well done and the visual storytelling is amazing. Also, all the puzzles are so good!!
it's a LOT of game for the money. a must have experience for a group of friends and some beers!

welp I regret purchasing this on sale a while back in anticipating of playing this with a VR headset.  Well I just got the Frame and it doesn't work.

2FA always asks for authentication even if you asked it to remember.  If you try to launch in VR mode, no way to authenticate the game as no inputs work.  If you do 2FA through a normal monitor it'll reset your mouse input so you have to be quick to click buttons or else it'll reset the position of your mouse.

If you try to launch the 2D mode and then toggle into VR, it'll basically not work on Frame.  This game shouldn't be sold on steam due to how unsupported it is and it's not even an old game.

I'm glad I don't bother to buy EA games any more, they really don't give a ♥♥♥♥.  Shame, I heard this one was good when it came out and I missed out just because I didn't play it on time.

Good game, undermined by few NPCs. Seriously, this one group looks like they walked straight out of a nightclub. Something went wrong with their outfits. I get the humor, but it looks like parody. It just doesn't fit the vibe. The rest is top-tier. I recommend it, but preferably on sale. I prefer New Order and Return to Castle (intro with Heinrich I still rules).
Do not ruin the experience for you: play at night, play alone, play in the dark, play with the sound loud. Absolute masterpiece of the game! Be ready to ♥♥♥♥ your pants.

Oh my god... what can I say about this game...? Its' just a masterpiece all the way around. Maybe only 30 minutes in and I was completely enraptured and enthralled by the story. I feel like that doesn't happen with ever game; it's rare.

The music is phenomenal. Incredible that the composer was just a guy they found on SoundCloud. There really are some fantastic artists out there just waiting to be discovered.

The story was quite unique, moving, and nuanced.

This game is one of my favorites of all time now...
i've never seen a game fall off the way this one does in the second act, it's actually tragic.
